name: Central Washington Spring 2022

venue.name: SURC Building, Central Washington University
venue.details: Room 137, downstairs across from the cafeteria

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CentralWashingtonSpring2022#18346-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

## **PLEASE NOTE: There is another competition in the area on the same day: [Bothell Spring 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BothellSpring2022). Keep this in mind when deciding whether to register.**

For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)!

Please be aware of Covid-19 precautions and read [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CentralWashingtonSpring2022#18335-health-and-safety) before registering.
